findings.title: Concurrent fresh database startup can fail before migration locking
findings.trigger: Two separate processes open the same previously absent production.sqlite simultaneously. One exited SQLITE_BUSY at journal_mode=WAL; the other opened successfully.
findings.expected: Both bounded opens succeed and observe one contiguous migration history, or contention is handled with an explicit bounded retry; no duplicate migrations.
findings.requiredFix: Apply busy timeout before WAL transition and robustly handle WAL setup contention if needed. Add actual separate-process fresh database and true-v1 concurrent startup regression.
findings.reproduction: python3 /tmp/perabyte-b2-startup.py; exact source frozen at actualSHA. Independent run produced fresh children exit1/0 and v1 exit0/0.

checks.result: Fresh DB simultaneous opens failed one child; true-v1 opens both passed. Both databases had exact001/002 history, integrity ok, no foreign key violations.
